study type: Cross-sectional study nested in a cohort
cohort: The study included 3,751 postpartum women from Ribeirao Preto and 3,275 from Sao Luis, who delivered between 2010-2011 as part of the BRISA cohort studies.
finding: The prevalence of self-reported UI at 12-24 months postpartum was higher in Ribeirao Preto (16.3%) than in Sao Luis (11.4%), and weight gain during pregnancy was strongly associated with UI in Ribeirao Preto.
